assumptions.statement: Exact official site and key-area polygons are unavailable; repository provisional rough polygons are used only for package generation and conceptual review.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-sensitive metrics and figures require full recalculation after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire, heritage, rail and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No FAR, height, demolition, road, utility or engineering feasibility conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: No non-public medical records, provider capacity, clinical workflow or institution-specific data is used.
assumptions.impact: Health scenarios are service-design concepts requiring qualified clinical, ethical, legal and cybersecurity review.

assumptions.statement: Robot, autonomous shuttle and drone paths are conceptual risk tiers, not approved operating routes.
assumptions.impact: Deployment requires traffic, airspace, safety, accessibility and public-space approval plus human takeover protocols.
